name: Organic Fresh Tomatoes
description: Freshly picked organic tomatoes from our local farm. No pesticides, 100% natural.
details: Premium quality organic tomatoes grown without any synthetic pesticides or fertilizers. Harvested at peak ripeness for maximum flavor and nutrition. Perfect for salads, cooking, and sauces.

name: Homemade Organic Peanut Butter
description: Rich, creamy peanut butter made from organic roasted peanuts. No sugar added!
details: Handcrafted peanut butter made from 100% organic peanuts. Contains no added sugar, salt, or preservatives. Rich source of protein and healthy fats.

name: Farm Fresh Free-Range Eggs
description: Golden, nutritious eggs from free-range organic hens. Rich in omega-3s!
details: Farm fresh eggs from free-range hens fed on organic grain. High in choline and lutein for eye health. Each dozen contains vibrant golden yolks indicating superior nutrition.

name: Organic Honey - Raw & Unfiltered
description: Pure raw honey straight from our bee hives. No heating or processing.
details: Golden raw honey harvested directly from our sustainable bee hives. Packed with enzymes, minerals, and antioxidants. Perfect for sweetening and medicinal uses.

name: Homemade Organic Granola
description: Crunchy granola with organic oats, nuts, and dried fruits. Zero artificial ingredients.
details: Handmade granola with certified organic oats, almonds, walnuts, and raisins. Sweetened naturally with honey. Great source of fiber and energy.

name: Organic Spinach & Kale Mix
description: Fresh organic leafy greens loaded with vitamins and minerals.
details: Certified organic baby spinach and kale blend. Packed with iron, calcium, and antioxidants. Perfect for salads, smoothies, and cooking.

name: Homemade Pasta - Whole Wheat
description: Freshly made whole wheat pasta. High in fiber and protein.
details: Artisanal whole wheat pasta made with organic grains. Rich in fiber, promotes digestive health. Cooks perfectly in just 8-10 minutes.

name: Organic Almond Milk - Unsweetened
description: Creamy almond milk with no added sugars. Perfect dairy alternative.
details: Made from organic almonds, water, and a touch of sea salt. No gums, no carrageenan. Rich, creamy texture. Ideal for coffee, cereal, and smoothies.
